anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals, indicating potential performance bottlenecks.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, confidence, or opportunities, suggesting possible issues with AI functionality.
Trading system shows zero active trades and zero total profit/loss, which may indicate a lack of trading activity or issues with strategy execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review and potentially update AI models or data inputs to ensure they are functioning and generating insights as expected.
Evaluate the current trading strategies and market conditions to ensure they are aligned and capable of executing trades effectively.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve any underlying issues.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to degraded system performance and impact trading operations, potentially causing financial losses.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to identify why it is not generating learning cycles or opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: AI functionality is crucial for identifying trading opportunities and optimizing strategies; any issues here could hinder trading performance.
